phase_name: Audit the Acceptance Criteria Against File Contents

Confirm no guidance depends on a prompting tool
Confirm the 9-tool list matches the allowlist exactly across three files
Confirm no invented tool name survives as usable guidance in source store
Confirm deferred status genuinely flipped, usage conditions preserved
Confirm mcp-server-ownership.md reference follows house convention
